name: WP eCards – Branded Digital Greeting Cards
author: Tim from eCardWidget

sections.description:
Add a branded eCard form or eCard gallery directly to your WordPress site with just a few clicks. Visitors can browse your collection of digital greeting cards, personalize a message, and send it instantly via email or social media — no coding required.

Perfect for organizations, nonprofits, churches, and businesses looking to engage their community, show appreciation, or run creative campaigns with custom-designed cards.

This plugin is powered by eCardWidget — the leading platform for customizable digital greeting card forms used by top brands and mission-driven organizations.

Why Add Digital Greeting Cards?

Boost engagement. Encourage sharing. Celebrate people. Whether it’s for volunteer appreciation, donor thank-yous, team recognition, or holiday outreach — eCards help you connect in a meaningful way.

Popular Use Cases
Explore how businesses, nonprofits, and churches are using eCards to boost engagement and grow impact: See real examples

🚀 New: Built-in WooCommerce Integration!

Easily sell digital eCards as WooCommerce products and let customers send cards right after checkout. No extra plugin required—it’s all built-in! Perfect for organizations, nonprofits, churches, and businesses who want to offer eCards with full e-commerce power.

Features

  • Embed branded eCard galleries or individual cards anywhere using a simple shortcode
  • Fully customizable card designs, branding, and messaging
  • Add your logo, links, and custom background
  • Choose from a professional template library or upload your own artwork
  • Track sent cards and export sender/recipient emails (CSV)
  • Reliable email delivery with spam protection
  • Emoji and animated GIF support
  • Responsive design, mobile-friendly
  • BCC all outgoing eCards for recordkeeping
  • Change layouts, fonts, and colors to match your site
  • Custom CSS support
  • Send eCards to Facebook friends
  • Built-in analytics to track card engagement
  • Multilingual support (French, German, Dutch, Spanish, Hebrew, Polish, and more)
  • And many more features!

sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for WP eCards and click Install Now
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Sign up at eCardWidget.com for a free account
  5. Create your Widget (eCard gallery or campaign), add your cards
  6. Copy your Widget shortcode and paste it into any page or post
